target_customer: Employers that buy a sleep benefit for employees and their families
problem: Employees sleep poorly, which hurts health and productivity, and employers lack an affordable coaching-based sleep benefit.
business_model: B2B employer subscription for an app plus coaching program

founders.name: Ali Abramovitz Cook
prior_employers: A hedge fund (analyst, name not stated)
founders.background_notes: Business and product work at Twilio per the YC page.

founders.name: MK Hurlbutt
founders.role: Co-founder, Chief of Experience and Community

founders.name: Warren Runk
founders.background_notes: Long-time software engineer per the YC page.

competitors.name: Sleepio (Big Health)
competitors.what: Digital CBT-I sleep program sold to employers and pharmacy benefit managers
competitors.traction_then: Sold as an employer benefit since 2016; deployed through CVS Caremark

competitors.name: Calm
competitors.what: Consumer meditation and sleep app with an employer offering

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile app with lessons, audio and coaching delivery; no novel technology at founding. The later AI coach Luna came after the batch.

defensibility.rationale: Content and coaching are replicable, and larger sleep and meditation brands already sold to employers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals kept selling employer sleep programs; no source shows them acquiring Chorus. Sleep Reset, a virtual sleep clinic, bought it in April 2026.

market_need_then: Employer demand for digital sleep benefits existed: Sleepio was marketed to employers from 2016 and Calm and Headspace sold workplace tiers. No Chorus-specific demand data found.

branding.domain_note: chorussleep.com redirects to thesleepreset.com after the 2026 acquisition.

identity.mascot_or_character: Luna, the AI coaching agent (later product)

brand_strength.rationale: Little press on the brand itself; the name was folded into Sleep Reset after acquisition.

outcome_analysis: Chorus Sleep stayed small for years, backed by YC, Precursor Ventures and Goat Capital per the acquirer's release. It was acquired by Sleep Reset in April 2026 for undisclosed terms, with the CEO and CTO advising on the transition. The release does not say whether this was a strong exit or a soft landing, so the result is recorded without a verdict.
notes: Directory status says Active but the acquirer's release dated 2026-04-22 confirms an acquisition. The YC round is recorded as other with no amount: CB Insights lists conflicting figures (130K seed versus a 0.5M convertible note dated 2021-02-19), both aggregator-only. An aggregator also claims 2M dollars revenue in 2024 and an M&A offer in 2025; unverified and not used. Investor names Precursor Ventures and Goat Capital come from the acquirer's release without round dates. Education not found for any founder. Competitor sources are dated 2016 or undated; Calm and Headspace rows come from 2020s pages.
